name: How does insulation affect indoor air quality?
description: Proper insulation can improve indoor air quality by sealing out pollutants, but material choice and ventilation are crucial.

mainEntity.name: How does insulation affect indoor air quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper insulation, particularly when combined with air sealing, can improve indoor air quality by preventing outside pollutants and allergens from entering your home through gaps and cracks. However, it's important to use materials that are low in VOCs (volatile organic compounds) and ensure adequate ventilation to maintain a healthy indoor environment.
